dailyVerse.verseEnglish: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.
dailyVerse.verseTelugu: శాంతిని మీకు విడిచిపోవుచున్నాను; నా శాంతినే మీకు ఇచ్చుచున్నాను. లోకమిచ్చునట్లుగా నేను మీకు ఇవ్వడము లేదు. మీ హృదయమును కలవరపడనియ్యకుడి, వెరవనియ్యకుడి.
keyTakeaways: Christ's peace is not dependent on circumstances or worldly wealth.
His peace anchors the believer against fear, distress, and confusion.
We receive this divine peace freely through prayer, trust, and surrender.
dailyVerse.reflection: The peace Jesus offers is not merely the absence of trouble; it is His living presence in the midst of every storm. While worldly peace is fragile and conditional, Jesus gives us an unchanging foundation. When anxiety strikes, anchor your mind on this truth: Emmanuel is with you.
dailyVerse.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your gift of perfect peace. In moments of uncertainty, anxiety, and fear, quiet my soul with the assurance of Your presence. Guard my heart and mind, and let Your peace reign in every area of my life. Amen.

recentVerses.text: Agree with God, and be at peace; thereby good will come to you.
The LORD lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness...
Strive for peace with everyone, and for the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.

startNewLife.heroTitle: Start a New Life with Jesus
startNewLife.heroSubtitle: This Could Be Your New Beginning. You’ve felt something in your heart… This is not a coincidence. God is calling you right now.
theTruthPoints: We are all separated from God because of sin (Romans 3:23).
We cannot fix or save ourselves by good works (Ephesians 2:8-9).
Jesus died on the cross and rose again to give us brand new life (Romans 5:8).
startNewLife.keyScripture: John 3:3 — “Unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”
startNewLife.sinnersPrayer:
Lord Jesus,
I know I am a sinner.
Please forgive my sins.
Come into my life.
Change my heart.
From today, I choose to follow You.
I surrender my life to You.
Amen.
